description: Orchestrates fulfillment tasks for New Hire Equipment Bundle requests. Creates child tasks, waits for completion, closes RITM, and sends notifications.
reason: Flow Designer flows must be created via ServiceNow UI - not deployable via REST API

flowSteps.name: Create Fulfillment Tasks
Wait for All Tasks Complete

conditions.description: All child tasks with parent = trigger RITM have state = Closed Complete

flowSteps.checkScript:
var util = new NewHireBundleUtil();
return util.areAllTasksComplete(trigger.sys_id);

flowSteps.name: Get Notification Recipients

creationInstructions: 1. Navigate to Flow Designer: Process Automation > Flow Designer
6. Add Trigger Condition: stage = request_approved AND cat_item.name = New Hire Equipment Bundle
7. Add Action: 'Script Step' - Create Fulfillment Tasks (use NewHireBundleUtil)
8. Add Action: 'Wait for Condition' - All child sc_task records closed
9. Add Action: 'Script Step' - Close RITM Complete
testingSteps: 1. Submit a New Hire Equipment Bundle catalog request
3. Verify 3 catalog tasks are created (Laptop, Access, Welcome Kit)
5. Verify RITM auto-closes when last task closes
6. Verify email notifications sent to requester and hiring manager
